snippet.title: CottageCore - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Build a village to call home through the winter.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4941950/CottageCore/
- Shape cottages and towers, care for your villagers, and prepare for winter. Build freely in Creative, or guide your village through the seasons in God of the Glade.
- Coming April 14, 2027 to Windows PC.
- Footage captured from an alpha build.
